# 0004 – Placeholder art generated by code

**Date:** 2026-10-23 · **Status:** accepted

## Context
We need art for every zone of the climb (Earth → sky → space → moon) before anyone has time to draw it.

## Decision
Generate the first set of sprites with a seeded Python script (`tools/art/generate_art.py`) using one shared palette (based on Endesga 32).

## Why
- One consistent style and palette across ~30 assets from day one.
- The AI can change any asset by editing code and re-running, and every change shows up as a readable diff.
- Same sizes and frame layouts as final art, so swapping in hand-drawn PNGs later needs no code changes.

## Alternatives
Free asset packs (e.g. Kenney, OpenGameArt). Still possible for specific things; they'd need to fit the palette and 16px tile grid.

## Consequences
Hand-edited PNGs must be removed from the generator, or re-running it overwrites them.
